title: Glitch Invaders: On-Call
tagline: Shoot the bugs, then debug the three that fight back using Sentry evidence.
learning_objectives: reading stack traces and error context
tracing a logic bug with breadcrumbs
spotting bottlenecks in a performance trace

steps.title: Launch your patch drone
steps.hint: Press Start in the game, then shoot the first glitches.
steps.done_when: The page shows the line "glitch-state v1 …" containing "launched=yes".

steps.title: Fix the jammed weapon
steps.hint: Grab the gold upgrade and fire. Then trace the error in the Incident Console.
steps.done_when: The page shows the line "glitch-state v1 …" containing "weapon=repaired".

steps.title: Fix the shield that hurts
steps.hint: Grab the blue shield and take a hit. Read the breadcrumbs, then patch it.
steps.done_when: The page shows the line "glitch-state v1 …" containing "shield=repaired".

steps.title: Fix the slow boss spawn
steps.hint: Clear the wave so the boss spawns. Find the bottleneck in the trace.
steps.done_when: The page shows the line "glitch-state v1 …" containing "boss=repaired".

steps.title: Tell your guide what you found
steps.hint: Say which clue helped most: the stack trace, the breadcrumbs, or the trace.
steps.done_when: All three fixes are repaired and the participant has told the guide, in their own words, which evidence helped them find a cause.
